title: Nonabelian Torus Exteriors in $\mathbb S^4$ and Torus Replacement in Four-Manifolds
summary: We study torus-exterior replacement in four-manifolds, with the construction controlled by the peripheral homomorphism. Using torus exteriors arising from the work of Boyle and Kanenobu-Kazama, with explicitly controlled fundamental groups and peripheral systems, we construct smooth homotopy 4-spheres and manifolds homeomorphic to S^2 x S^2 and \#_3(S^2 x S^2). We also study direct gluings of two torus exteriors.
